title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: card flavor text

entities.name: Vernon Fenwick
entities.description: A member of a news crew who hopes to avoid another wild turtle chase.

entities.name: Agent Bishop
entities.description: A man in black who plays the Utroms and Triceratons against each other to get them off his planet.

entities.name: Utroms
entities.description: Aliens who use exoskeletons and false skins and took up residence on Earth after their ship crashed.

entities.name: Triceratons
entities.description: An alien people who fight for the glory of the Republic.

entities.name: Donatello
entities.description: One of the four turtle brothers, an intelligent technician who builds devices such as a pan-dimensional portal.

entities.name: Azrael
entities.description: The East Wind Avatar, born on the wind to guide others to new beginnings.

entities.name: Pete
entities.description: A featherbrained filcher who introduces himself cheerfully.

entities.name: Ace Duck
entities.description: A high-flying ace who mocks a foe's goons.

entities.name: Jennika
entities.description: A mutant ninja who believes ninjas should fight for the people, as Splinter taught.

entities.name: Splinter
entities.description: The rat ninja master and teacher of the turtles.

entities.name: Koya
entities.description: A predator who strikes from above.

entities.name: Leonardo
entities.description: One of the four turtle brothers, a tactician and leader.

entities.name: Old Hob
entities.description: A mutant alleycat who leads a scrappy band of mutants.

entities.name: Mighty Mutanimals
entities.description: A scrappy band of mutants that stirs up trouble.

entities.name: Raphael
entities.description: One of the four turtle brothers, a tough fighter prone to anger.

entities.name: Pepperoni
entities.description: A prehistoric pet the turtles consider one of them.

entities.name: Sally Pride
entities.description: A lioness leader who wants to end squalor and fear.

entities.name: April O'Neil
entities.description: A resourceful human freelance reporter and hacktivist allied with the turtles.

entities.name: Stocktronics
entities.description: Maker of the buzz bots designed for autonomous pollination.

entities.name: Herman
entities.description: A crustacean commando with a box full of pain.

entities.name: Fugitoid
entities.description: Professor Honeycutt, whose mind was transferred into his robot assistant by a freak accident.

entities.name: Metalhead
entities.description: A robot that simulates dozens of fighting styles, including Foot ninjutsu.

entities.name: Foot Clan
entities.description: An ancient ninja clan over 1,500 years old that infiltrates systems from the shadows.

entities.name: Mondo Gecko
entities.description: A laid-back gecko mutant.

entities.name: Renet
entities.description: A temporal apprentice who time travels with the turtles.

entities.name: New York
entities.description: The city where the turtles live and fight.

entities.name: Earth
entities.description: The world where the Utroms crashed and the turtles live.

entities.name: Mashima
entities.description: A Foot mystic who would protect the soul of Oroku Saki at any cost.

entities.name: Shredder
entities.description: The leader of the Foot Clan and enemy of Hamato Splinter and the turtles.

entities.name: Madame Null
entities.description: A power broker planning to purge and prime the planet on schedule.

entities.name: Casey Jones
entities.description: A vigilante who fights criminals with improvised weapons.

entities.name: Savanti Romero
entities.description: An exile in time who threatens to erase the turtles' existence.

entities.name: Kuro Kabuto
entities.description: The Shredder's armor, symbol of Foot Clan leadership for over 1,500 years.

entities.name: Rat King
entities.description: Ruler of subjects who are everywhere you don't want to be.

entities.name: General Traag
entities.description: A stone general who serves Lord Krang.

entities.name: Krang
entities.description: An Utrom warlord whose exo-suit's Molecular Amplification lets him adapt his physical form.

entities.name: Sheena
entities.description: A musician in the band After the Bomb.

entities.name: After the Bomb
entities.description: A Mutant Town thrash metal band.

entities.name: Zodi
entities.description: A self-described company woman who enjoys her work.

entities.name: Baxter Stockman
entities.description: A scientist who commands the mousers and works alongside Saki.

entities.name: Mousers
entities.description: Robots built to remove rodents, commanded by Baxter Stockman.

entities.name: Purple Dragons
entities.description: Young street fighters who have beaten everything in their area except the turtles.

entities.name: Slash
entities.description: A reptile rampager claiming to know the true meaning of being a warrior.

entities.name: Wingnut
entities.description: A bat mutant who talks with his partner Screwloose.

entities.name: Screwloose
entities.description: Wingnut's companion.

entities.name: Toad Baron
entities.description: A host who keeps guests at his gathering with the help of Alberto.

entities.name: Alberto
entities.description: The Toad Baron's faithful frog butler.

entities.name: Groundchuck
entities.description: A mutant who busts through obstacles alongside Dirtbag.

entities.name: Dirtbag
entities.description: Groundchuck's partner who digs under obstacles.

entities.name: Michelangelo
entities.description: One of the four turtle brothers, a fun-loving pizza enthusiast.

entities.name: Mona Lisa
entities.description: A science student excited about being mutated.

entities.name: Uno
entities.description: One of April's Turtle tots carrying on the brothers' legacy.

entities.name: Moja
entities.description: One of April's Turtle tots carrying on the brothers' legacy.

entities.name: Odyn
entities.description: One of April's Turtle tots carrying on the brothers' legacy.

entities.name: Yi
entities.description: One of April's Turtle tots carrying on the brothers' legacy.

entities.name: Manmoth
entities.description: A primordial pachyderm who challenges others to see who is fittest.

entities.name: Bebop
entities.description: A thug paired with Rocksteady.

entities.name: Rocksteady
entities.description: A thug paired with Bebop.

entities.name: Venus
entities.description: A turtle torn between worlds, built from scraps and defined by self.

entities.name: Earth Protection Force
entities.description: Humans who specialize in teaching the unknown to fear them.

entities.name: Foot Elite
entities.description: The personal students of the Shredder, a reserve guard without equal.

entities.name: Genghis Frog
entities.description: A frog mutant who calls to free his brothers from human terror.

entities.name: Lita
entities.description: A child Michelangelo advises, who fears the Slithery.

entities.name: Muckman
entities.description: A putrid mutant glad not to work in the sewers.

entities.name: Dr. Jordan Perry
entities.description: A scientist who insists the anti-mutagen be ingested.

entities.name: Tokka
entities.description: A mutant paired with Rahzar who obeys their master.

entities.name: Rahzar
entities.description: A mutant paired with Tokka who obeys their master.

entities.name: Technodrome
entities.description: A magnificent wonder of alien technology, even unfinished.

entities.name: Dimension X
entities.description: A crazy backwards land.

entities.name: Mutant Town
entities.description: A place where mutated people are kept contained.

entities.name: TCRI Building
entities.description: The building from which the Translocation Matrix's light was seen throughout the city.

entities.name: Translocation Matrix
entities.description: Utrom device whose accidental activation gave them a brief window to escape.

entities.name: Kitsune
entities.description: The dragon's daughter, who offers retribution and uses foes' footwork against them.

entities.name: Karai
entities.description: A ninja who teaches that losing one's temper loses the battle.

entities.name: Path of the Four Winds
entities.description: A quest for knowledge to the serpent, jaguar, dragon and eagle.

entities.name: Glyph
entities.description: The North Wind Avatar, whose ever-changing origin stories always bear a lesson.

entities.name: Snake-Eyes
entities.description: The South Wind Avatar, whose gift takes others back to their worst memory.

entities.name: Armaggon
entities.description: A future shark who calls himself mutation come full circle.

entities.name: Cudley
entities.description: A giant disembodied cyborg cow head that travels through time and space.

events.summary: A freak accident transfers Professor Honeycutt's mind into his robot assistant; blamed for his own death, he flees as the Fugitoid.
events.quote: A freak accident transferred Professor Honeycutt's mind into his robot assistant. Blamed for his own death, he fled . . . as the FUGITOID!

events.summary: The Utroms crash on Earth and take up residence there in disguise.
events.quote: Using exoskeletons and false skins, the utroms took up residence on Earth after their ship crashed.

events.summary: The Translocation Matrix is accidentally activated at the TCRI Building, giving the Utroms a brief window to escape.
events.quote: The utroms knew they only had a brief window to escape after its accidental activation.

events.summary: General Traag arrives to conquer for Lord Krang.
events.quote: "Lord Krang, we arrive. We obey. We conquer."

events.summary: Baxter Stockman commands the mousers to consume everything.
events.quote: "The mousers have a new command: to consume everything here . . . all of you will be destroyed!"
